disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandoning a roofing contract without legal grounds after a deposit has been paid.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandon a roofing contract without legal grounds after a deposit of money or other consideration has been paid;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Diverting funds or property entrusted to a roofing contractor.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: divert any funds or property entrusted to a roofing contractor;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in fraudulent or deceptive acts or practices or misrepresentation of products, services or qualifications.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engage in any fraudulent or deceptive acts or practices or misrepresentation of products, services or qualifications as a roofing contractor;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a false or misleading statement in an application for registration or in soliciting a contract.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: make a false or misleading statement in an application for a roofing contractor registration certificate or renewal application or in soliciting a contract for roofing services;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any judgment or order by a court of competent jurisdiction against the roofing contractor.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violate any judgment or order by a court of competent jurisdiction against the roofing contractor for a violation of the provisions of this act;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in work without a valid registration certificate or performing services during a period when the certificate is denied, suspended or revoked.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engage in work without a valid registration certificate as required for roofing contractors pursuant to this act or performing roofing services during any period when the roofing contractor's registration certificate is denied, suspended or revoked;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in roofing services without obtaining a proper permit as required by state or local authority.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engage in roofing services without obtaining a proper permit as may be required by any state or local authority;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with tax laws authorized by the state or any of its political subdivisions.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fail to comply with any tax laws authorized by the state or any of its political subdivisions;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Damaging or injuring any person or property while performing roofing services with inadequate liability insurance or workers' compensation coverage.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: damage or injure any person or property while performing roofing services under a valid roofing contractor registration certificate for which the roofing contractor's liability insurance or workers' compensation coverage was inadequate;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with any provision of the roofing contractor act or any rule and regulation adopted thereunder.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fail to comply with any provision of this act or any rule and regulation adopted thereunder.

insurance_required.quote: A copy of the roofing contractor's certificate of liability insurance shall be filed with the application and shall be not less than $500,000.

definition_quote.value: "Roofing contractor" means any person, including a subcontractor and nonresident contractor, who in the ordinary course of business: (A) Engages in the business of commercial or residential roofing services for a fee; or (B) offers to engage in or solicits roofing-related services, including construction, installation, renovation, repair, maintenance, alteration and waterproofing.

registration_number_required_in_ads.quote: A roofing contractor shall display such contractor's roofing contractor registration certificate number issued pursuant to this act on each commercial vehicle used for roofing services and upon every business sign, card, correspondence and contract used to solicit and conduct roofing services in this state.

insurance_personal_injury_minimum_usd.quote: A copy of the roofing contractor's certificate of liability insurance shall be filed with the application and shall be not less than $500,000.

self_insurance_permitted.quote: Proof satisfactory to the attorney general that the applicant has secured either workers' compensation coverage satisfactory under the workers' compensation act or an affidavit of exemption or self-insurance as authorized pursuant to the workers' compensation act.

minimum_project_value_usd.quote: any person who engages in providing roofing services that on each and every undertaking or project during any fiscal year bear an aggregate price, including labor, materials and all other items, that is quoted, bid, offered, agreed, contracted, billed, collected and paid at less than $2,000.

out_of_state_disciplinary_action_reporti.quote: Has or has not been registered or licensed as a roofing contractor in another state; and whether any disciplinary action was taken against such registration or license or whether such registration or license is currently in good standing.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Liability limitation clause (limiting contractor liability to cost of inspection report or contract price)
Indemnification / hold-harmless clause favoring the promisee's sole negligence
Waiver of consumer cancellation rights clause
Waiver of consumer rights (general statutory rights) clause
Blank spaces clause (material terms left blank for later completion)
scope__voidable_contract_clauses.quote: does not contain blank spaces that may be subsequently filled in with terms or conditions that materially affect the timing, value or obligation of the contract unless such terms and conditions are separately acknowledged in writing by the distributed energy customer

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Assignment of insurance proceeds clause (without owner consent / in violation of statutory requirements)
scope__voidable_contract_clauses.quote: An assignment is void if the residential contractor: (1) Violates any provision of this section; or (2) is not in compliance with any of the requirements of the Kansas roofing registration act.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Clause authorizing unlawful entry or breach of peace for repossession
Lien disclosure notice omission (failure to include required lien disclosure)
Disclaimer or limitation of implied warranty clause
Clause entered into by unlicensed contractor (contract with unlicensed contractor)
scope__voidable_contract_clauses.quote: No person may bring or maintain any claim, action, suit, or proceeding in any court of this state related to such person's business or capacity as a roofing contractor without having a valid registration certificate as required by this act.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Clause requiring compliance waiver from applicable building codes or zoning regulations
Distributed energy contract clause failing to meet statutory disclosure or terms requirements
scope__voidable_contract_clauses.quote: If a distributed energy retailer fails to comply with this section, any contract entered into between the distributed energy retailer and the distributed energy customer that pertains to the distributed energy system shall be deemed null and void.
